_comment: Shared point -> expected-hood_id fixture, per hood-dataset/TRD.md sec 4.4 (C-HOOD-1 clause 4) and sec 11 B1. Asserted against BOTH database/scripts/validate_dataset.py's resolve_hood() (T-040/T-042, offline) and T-043's live-events-pipeline plpgsql hood_for_point() (in-database) -- two separate implementations of the same even-odd ray cast, held to one spec: closed single-ring WGS84 [[lng,lat],...], bbox prefilter, on-boundary -> no Hood (null). Written first by T-040's build (data-engineer); T-042 and T-043 consume it and must not add a case to one side without adding it here for both.
algorithmSpec: even-odd ray cast, bbox prefilter, on-boundary returns no containing Hood (null) -- see hood-dataset/TRD.md sec 2.2

cases.description: Shared boundary vertex between Florentin and Neve Sha'anan -- created by this dataset's V6 non-overlap snap fix (hood-dataset PRD Decisions log, 2026-07-31): a ~18m source-imprecision sliver was resolved by moving one Neve Sha'anan vertex onto the matching Florentin vertex, so the two rings now share this exact point on their common edge. On-boundary must resolve to no Hood in both implementations, not to either neighbour.
Mediterranean Sea, off the Tel Aviv coast -- no Hood covers open water

Inland gap between non-adjacent hoods (central Tel Aviv, north of Old North's authored polygon) -- not every square meter of the city is covered by a named Hood in this dataset, and an uncovered point must resolve to no Hood rather than to the nearest one
